Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: VHF (2 m)
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 144 to 148 MHz. Line of sight; cheap, light and reliable outdoors, but blocked by terrain and heavy walls.

Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: UHF (70 cm)
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 430 to 450 MHz. Shorter line of sight than VHF, but copes better inside buildings and mountain bases.

Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: air band (VHF)
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 117.975 to 137 MHz. Aircraft talk to the ground and each other here, by AM voice. A station needs an aviation transceiver and aviation antennas to join in.

Phobos.Radio.BandDef.label: military UHF
Phobos.Radio.BandDef.description: 225 to 400 MHz. Military aircraft talk here, by AM voice. A station needs an aviation transceiver and aviation antennas to join in.
